title: /cd Session Moves and Nested Sub-Agents
description: Week 24 (June 8-12, 2026): /cd command moves current session to new working directory mid-conversation without rebuilding prompt cache. Sub-agents can now spawn their own sub-agents (capped at five levels deep), --safe-mode starts with all customizations disabled, and fallbackModel configures up to three fallback models.

community_feedback.quote: Subagents are not a speed trick, they're a memory trick
Subagents in Claude Code are now composable - up to 5 levels deep

title: Auto Mode on Third-Party Providers
description: Week 23 (June 1-5, 2026): Auto mode now available on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry for Opus 4.7 and Opus 4.8, replacing permission prompts with background safety checks. Also includes safer automatic edits, /plugin list command, and version requirements for managed deployments.

title: Bugbot Performance Improvements - 3x Faster
description: June 10, 2026: Bugbot is now over 3x faster, 22% cheaper, and finds 10% more bugs. Average review time reduced to ~90 seconds from ~5 minutes. Also added /review command to run Bugbot before pushing, only review what's new in PR, and Design Mode improvements with multi-select elements and voice input.

community_feedback.quote: Loving the new BugBot PR check - caught great little gotchas within just a few days
Cursor suggestions averaged 75-85% accuracy depending on task complexity

title: Canvas Design Mode and Context Usage Report
description: June 2026: Introduced Design Mode for faster canvas editing, new context usage report showing interactive breakdown of token usage, and Organizations management for Enterprise customers with multi-team support.

title: Usage-Based Billing Transition
description: June 1, 2026: GitHub Copilot completed transition to usage-based billing where every suggestion, chat completion, and code review consumes credits. May updates included Visual Studio enhancements and agentic workflows with cloud agent sessions.

community_feedback.quote: End of an Era - goodbye $10 flat-fee subscription model
Users tracking premium token usage expressed concerns about new billing direction
Promotional credit period for Business and Enterprise customers (June-September 2026)

title: Users Tab Renamed to Members and Devin Review
description: June 10, 2026: Org membership page tab renamed to 'Members' for clarity. New Devin Review feature for pending PRs, with auto-cancel on new commits. Also includes large paste auto-attach as files, user mentions rendered as styled links, and official Figma MCP integration.

title: v0.86.2 Stable Release and Model Support
description: June 2026: Latest stable release v0.86.2 with last repository push on May 22, 2026. Added DeepSeek Reasoner model and expanded Gemini model support. Aider writes 70-80% of its own code in each release.

title: Codex CLI 0.140.0 Released
description: June 15, 2026: Added /usage views for daily, weekly, and cumulative account token activity. /goal now preserves oversized text and image attachments. Added permanent session deletion through codex delete, /import for Claude Code migration, and managed Amazon Bedrock API-key authentication.

community_feedback.quote: Praise for code review and quality control features, especially the /review command
Codex CLI gave incorrect code recommendations based on outdated information
Questioning the hype around Codex CLI

title: Codex CLI 0.139.0 Released
description: June 9, 2026: Code mode can now call standalone web search directly. Tool and connector input schemas preserve oneOf and allOf. Plugin marketplace automation more informative with JSON output. Improved image edits using exact file paths and safer automatic edits in acceptEdits mode.

community_feedback.quote: Codex CLI usage limits decreased by 4x or more
Codex has been much better than Gemini CLI for me so far
Big update incoming with improvements for large repositories

title: Gemini CLI Shutdown Announcement
description: June 18, 2026: Google is shutting down Gemini CLI for free, Pro, and Ultra users. A migration guide has been published for builders. Latest release v0.45.0 included routing optimizations and bypassed classifiers for specific tool responses.
